items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified history)
items.quote: 24:9 Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
items.claim: The text says that Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu and seventy elders of Israel went up. The document doesn't say where they went. From memory (model-prior, unverified), this is Exodus 24:9 in the King James Version, and the place is Mount Sinai.
items.actor: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel

items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative; theophany account, not historically verifiable)
items.quote: 24:10 And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
items.claim: The text says that the group saw the God of Israel. It describes what was under his feet as being like a paved work of sapphire stone, as clear as the sky itself.
items.actor: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel
items.object: the God of Israel; a paved work of a sapphire stone under his feet
